about: Shilpa Medicare Incorporated in 1987 manufactures niche APIs, intermediates, and formulations and also undertakes contract research and manufacturing service for some of its customers. The company’s formulation products consist of 16 injectable dosage forms, 19 oral solid dosage forms under SML and 13 formulations under SML’s wholly owned subsidiary Shilpa Therapeutics. [1]
